verdict.rationale: First-party help docs show native QuickBooks Online and NetSuite connections. Finalized reports export automatically, and a daily sync pulls in the chart of accounts and customers/projects. Xero appears in the official integrations list, and 'multi-level GL coding' is advertised, so the core accounting sync with GL coding is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of class and department mapping controls, any Xero-specific configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mapping behavior.
